scope: MEAS: independent gates/report, source, published note/bar-map, complete-sheet and visual review; not aural review.

defects.finding: The actual engraved page has no repeat markers at bar 8 beat 3 or bar 16 beat 3, although the performed map repeats that exact span. The immutable LilyPond source encodes those boundaries in a legacy repeat-volta-count-1 spacer voice; modern engraving suppresses its intended repeat notation.
defects.requiredFix: Restore the existing source-encoded start/end repeat marks at precisely bar 8 quarter offset 2 and bar 16 quarter offset 2 using a guarded layout-compatible repair. Preserve the immutable MIDI, all musical notes, the 25 printed bar identities and exact fractional performed traversal; do not substitute whole-bar repeats or invent extra bars. Re-publish and record the legacy repeat-visibility repair in the report/provenance, then inspect both markers on the actual SVG.

report.finding: The report matches final numeric gates, 580 notes / two source staves, exact half-open quarter-offset order and 25-bar pack. It must additionally record the repeat-visibility repair; current numerical success does not resolve the missing notation.

barMap.finding: All 580 note bar/voice indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Actual SVG/index sets are pickup 0 and 1–24; partial occurrences of bars 8 and 16 are intentional. The complete page and magnified repeat boundaries were inspected. Approximate listen transitions near 14/40 s are consistent with the middle-strain pickup/return, not whole-bar substitutes.

overlays.finding: No gross pitch/order mismatch identified. Both middle-strain traversals and the written opening return remain, with the genuine final chord near 54.448 s and estimated 56.68 s display end. This does not repair the absent printed repeat markers or establish physical releases.

version.finding: Complete piano No. 6 with the eight-bar middle span repeated from its pickup. The exact performed order is coherent with pitch trajectories/recurrence, but the current sheet omits the encoded repeat signs and cannot yet be accepted as the matching notation.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; no physical Betts edition is identified.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check performed by VerS. Numeric onset success is not proof that legacy engraving directives survived conversion.
